mathematical_meanings: Left image: O names the center of the circle (the interior dot in the circle with an inscribed quadrilateral). Right image: O names the center of the circle (the common endpoint of the segments to A and B).
Rationales: In both images, O names the center of the circle. The relevant locations are the interior dot in the circle with an inscribed quadrilateral on the left and the common endpoint of the segments to A and B on the right.
